value.loc: Abstract; Sec. 1 Introduction; Sec. 4 Rank aggregation
value.quote: extract the correct answers to questions, based on multiple answers
value.note: Main object is a truth-discovery heuristic for estimating crowdsourcing workers' competence from noisy labels in general domains; voting rules appear only as interchangeable aggregation functions estimating a ground truth (ML/statistical rank aggregation), not as a procedure producing a collective decision.

C0.reason: The paper is crowdsourcing truth discovery (competence estimation against a ground truth), matching the codebook's ML rank aggregation exclusion rather than collective decision-making by voting; B's quote trimmed to 12 words.
